entities.summary: Bernard Tschumi is an architect, writer, and educator, commonly associated with deconstructivism. Son of the well-known Swiss architect Jean Tschumi and a French mother, Tschumi is a dual French-Swiss national who works and lives in New York City and Paris. He studied in Paris and at ETH in Zurich, where he received his degree in architecture in 1969. Bernard Tschumi was a writers & intellectuals from Lausanne (b. 1944-01-25, Lausanne). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
